verdict.rationale: A government online filing portal like bizfile California could plausibly offer analytics or cookie opt-out controls, so the privacy-posture axis applies. However, no evidence item mentions telemetry, usage tracking, analytics, cookies, or any opt-out mechanism. The User Access controls govern who may file for an entity, not tracking, and the bot-management probe is unrelated.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
